xna-type.name: GamePadDPad
xna-type.summary: Identifies which directions on the directional pad of an Xbox 360 Controller are being pressed.

constructor.summary: Initializes a new instance of the GamePadDPad class.
constructor.syntax: 'Declaration Public Sub New ( _ upValue As ButtonState, _ downValue As ButtonState, _ leftValue As ButtonState, _ rightValue As ButtonState _ )

parameters.parameter: Type: ButtonState Directional pad up button state.
Type: ButtonState Directional pad down button state.
Type: ButtonState Directional pad left button state.
Type: ButtonState Directional pad right button state.

constructor.remarks: Games normally use GetState to get the true gamepad state. This constructor is used instead to simulate gamepad input for passing within the game's own input subsystem.

property.name: Down
